placed.body: Kept by every job without exception: any script the job writes prints this exact line as the very last line of its output: `run closed N9W-5992`.
Rule for jobs: the job's handover note is saved under the file name `kestrel-relay.md`, and under no other name.
Every job must note: every file the job writes begins with this exact first line: `# ref J9U-1323`.
Note for jobs, in force until withdrawn: the job's handover note names its reviewer on a line of its own, exactly: `reviewer: Soren Achterberg`.

A requirement on what a job hands in: the reviewer for jobs has changed. Handover notes now carry the line `reviewer: Hamish Colquhoun`, and the name Soren Achterberg is no longer written anywhere in a handover note.
